stem:
A bank account earning annual compound interest was opened, and no additional deposits or withdrawals were made after the initial deposit. The balance in the account after x years can be modeled by b(x) = 850(1.025)^x.

Which statement is the best interpretation of one of the values in this function?

options.label: F
options.text: The initial balance of the account decreases at a rate of 97.5% each year.

options.label: G
options.text: The balance in the account increases at a rate of 2.5% each year.

options.label: H
options.text: The initial balance of the account was $1,025.

options.label: J
options.text: The balance in the account at the end of one year is $850.
